component.name: ProbeScene
component.script: sub init() for row = 0 to 5 for col = 0 to 8 rect = m.top.CreateChild("Rectangle") rect.translation = [40 + col * 200 + (col mod 3), 40 + row * 160 + (row mod 3)] rect.width = 100 + (col \ 3) rect.height = 80 + (row \ 3) rect.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" end for end for end sub
